notes.title: Elypse Patch Note 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 📢

So here's a new important patch!
This one is here to discard what was our "assist mode" and change it into "Difficulty Settings".

Among other bugs fixes, we also patched the resolutions issues and 4K is now available.

⚙️ Patch note Elypse 1.0.8 ⚙️
- Resolution issues fixed
- 4K is now available
- Difficulty settings added
- Nyx not following Fay anymore corrected
- Some killzones and colliders adjustments
- Game duration statistic issues fixed

Thanks for following and supporting our work, we are doing our best to adapt to your feedbacks.

Cheers,
- Hot Chili Games.

tags.bug: - Resolution issues fixed
- Nyx not following Fay anymore corrected
- Game duration statistic issues fixed

notes.title: Update & News concerning Elypse development.
notes.content:
Hey there,

So we figured that it could be interesting to keep you posted about where we are at concerning Elypse development.

Every feature of the game are complete and we are now working on polishing the game and optimizing it. As performance was an issue on the demo.

Among the many polishes we are doing to Elypse, we are working on some features that have been reported by you, players.

We tweaked the jump to have a better fit to the gamefeel and feedbacks, and last but not least we are implementing a camera panning for release.

Other than that we are starting to talk about release with our publishers.
We will, of course, keep you posted.

Cheers everyone!
- Hot Chili Games.

notes.title: Changelog Elypse Demo 0.11.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope you are doing great and that you had a good time testing out Elypse!
Using all your feedbacks on Steam and Discord we runned some bugfix and updated the demo.

Here are the changelogs:
- Jump tweaked
- Fixed multiple colliders
- Game should not resume playing for a few seconds after returning to the main menu
- First checkpoint is no longer skippable
- Blocked the pause menu during the giant cutscene
- Chain dashing into a lava wall now correctly kills the player
- Fixed rebinding the arrow keys
- Fixed key bindings resetting when launching the game
- Updated some localization texts
- Fixed some tutorial line spacing and size
- Time in the stats tabs in now correctly tracked
- Added options menu in-game (Experimental, may have edge-case issues)

Special thanks to ImToxiiq & Borusse29 for reporting so many bugs!
See you for the next announcement!

Best,
- Hot Chili Games.
